name: Argelys Samuel Oriach | Systems Architect & Performance Artist
description: Argelys Samuel Oriach is a Brooklyn-based multidisciplinary artist, artistic director, and systems architect known for blending performance, design, and structural innovation across media. He constructs language for the room, page, stage, and screen. As founder and artistic director at Wild Lake Studio, he scouts and develops multidisciplinary artists whose practices, like his own, span multiple forms. His central offering to artists is his undivided attention.
